data.name: Little Samson
data.detailed_description:
Great Samsons Come in Little Packages!

Leaping, smashing, scorching, and exploding its way into your collection! Little Samson—the rarest and most coveted game of the 8-bit era—arrives on modern systems for everyone to enjoy!

Join Samson and his pals Gamm, K.O., and Kikara as they return to the Kingdom of Imperial Forgy and bring their fight against the nefarious Ta-Keed to the modern era. Featuring some of the best graphics and sound ever to appear in an NES game, Little Samson plays as great as it looks. Switch between the four heroes at will to overcome any challenge by climbing walls as Samson, bombing barriers as K.O., soaring over chasms as Kikara, and tanking deadly environments as the mighty Gamm. Discover alternate paths! Unlock hidden stages! Earn the true ending!

Powered by the Carbon Engine, Little Samson now comes packed with features:

  • Save your progress anywhere, any time!

  • Rewind the action to recover from accidents and mistakes!

  • Groove to the game tunes whenever you like with the music player feature!

  • Soak in history with an interactive museum featuring high-quality materials for both the U.S. and Japanese releases of the game!

Experience this legendary NES treasure for yourself! (And still be able to make rent for the next few months!)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core 2 Duo E7500
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit OS required)
  • Processor: AMD Phenon(TM) II X6 1035T @3100
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Raedon HD 7800 Series / NVIDIA
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
